kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app. store/apps/FashionFactory.json:28 primary_category LIFESTYLE; `grep -rn kidsAgeBand store/ratings` -> 0 hits; no KIDS category. Spec user is a 25-45-year-old online clothes shopper (FashionFactory.md:40).

banner.where: lib/features/home/home_screen.dart:438 (end of Home) and lib/features/brands/brand_screen.dart:98 (end of a brand page)

interstitial.why: Not used: grep for onTransition/Interstitial in lib/ finds 0 hits. AglAds is only configured and initialised (lib/main.dart:44-50). Keep it out. This is a task-focused utility (log an order, check a return deadline), and the spec removes the interstitial (FashionFactory.md:110,250).

native.why: There is no content feed. The only lists are the user's own order and return records, with sizes and prices paid (lib/features/orders/all_orders_screen.dart:80 ListView; lib/features/brands/brand_screen.dart:54). The spec removed deals, browse and catalogue (FashionFactory.md:57,70). An ad row between a person's purchase records is ad-in-personal-data, and most users keep few orders, so I chose no. Unsure whether the founder counts 'order history' as a feed: flagged.

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota or premium tier. 'Export orders (CSV)' is free (lib/features/settings/settings_screen.dart:150-154), and gating it would remove a feature.

blockers: agl_ads must be re-resolved to include agl-manifest cb21ee5 (AglNativeAd / showRewarded): pubspec.lock resolved-ref is d5e5b7269bce17efbf3fb9e0a331542e69c4cc26, which `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 d5e5b7269bce17efbf3fb9e0a331542e69c4cc26` reports does NOT contain cb21ee5 (pubspec.lock:17). Only relevant if a format is added later.
